title: Blood Orange Vodka Cocktail Recipe
ldIngredientsRaw: 100ml of vodka, preferable Black Cow Vodka
ldInstructionsRaw: Place all the cocktail ingredients except the cherries in a cocktail shaker. Shake well for 30 seconds until combined and lightly frothy
Divide between 2 coupes or cocktail glasses to serve, garnishing each drink with a cherry
